clues: This city in Norway lies on the south shore of a fjord. It sits where a river runs out into the sea.
For a place this far north, the climate is mild. By the sea, winters often stay above freezing, and summers stay mild too.
This place began in 997 as a small trade post. It stayed the capital of Norway through the Viking Age.
A football club called Rosenborg, the most winning club in Norway, plays its home games in this city. Kids here grow up cheering for it.
The Nidaros Cathedral stands in this city. It is the seat of church leaders for the whole wide area.
